love.summary: Most readers sense meaningful romantic shifts this week, whether through new connections, deepening bonds, or unexpected returns, so stay open to love arriving in forms you may not have anticipated.
love.disagreement: Some readers saw fresh romantic beginnings and exciting new offers, while one reading pointed to potential endings like divorce alongside those new starts.

finance.summary: Most readers see a financial turning point emerging this week, with stagnant or troubled situations giving way to new opportunities and long-term stability, so stay open and let go of what no longer serves your growth.
finance.disagreement: Some readers focused on resolving past difficulties, while others emphasized fresh opportunities arriving through new people or partnerships.

career.summary: Most readers this week see past opportunities or untapped paths circling back for Aquarius, so take bold, consistent action on whatever resurfaces, as it could set a meaningful new direction in motion.
career.disagreement: Some readers emphasized entirely new beginnings or bold career pivots, while others focused on returning opportunities and revisiting what was previously left behind.

family.summary: Family themes appear across several readings this week, with a sense that meaningful moments, whether a reunion, a heartfelt gesture from loved ones, or a turning point in domestic responsibilities, can spark renewed clarity and purpose at home.
family.disagreement: Some readers focused on emotional warmth and sweet surprises from family. Others highlighted heavier burdens or significant domestic changes reaching a resolution.

overall_tone_summary: A quiet optimism lifts Aquarius forward, with real change stirring beneath the surface.
